About ChatWizs

Expert-verified content for the modern web — built on transparency, experience, and trust.

Our Mission

ChatWizs is dedicated to providing high-quality, research-backed insights into SEO, technology, and digital marketing. In an era of AI-generated content, we stand for human expertise and full editorial accountability. Every article we publish must pass our 4-stage editorial process before going live.

Editorial Standards (Google EEAT Compliant)

✅
Experience

Every author has documented, first-hand experience in their field — no generalist writers.

🎓
Expertise

Articles are written by subject-matter experts with verifiable credentials and industry track records.

🏆
Authoritativeness

We cite primary sources, government data, and industry-leading references exclusively.

🛡️
Trustworthiness

All content is human-edited, fact-checked, and updated on a regular review cycle.

Our 4-Stage Editorial Process

01
Research & Outline

Topic validated against search intent and data-backed demand signals.

02
Expert Drafting

Written by a qualified author with direct experience in the subject area.

03
Editorial Review

Senior editor reviews for accuracy, EEAT compliance, and factual integrity.

04
Publish & Monitor

Live monitoring for accuracy updates; reviewed every 90 days minimum.

Corrections & Feedback Policy

We promptly correct factual errors upon verification. If you spot an inaccuracy, contact our editorial team. Corrections are noted inline on the affected article with a timestamp. See our full Editorial Guidelines and Fact-Checking Policy.

Get in Touch

For editorial inquiries, corrections, or collaboration opportunities.
